facts.text: Suspects cut catalytic converters from seven Second Harvest trucks at its Etobicoke yard over Thanksgiving weekend
Police responded at 12:16 a.m. Sunday, Oct. 11, 2026 to a theft call near The East Mall and North Queen St.
Police say suspect(s) drove in, cut the fence, removed converters and fled in the same vehicle
Suspect vehicle: black four-door Infiniti G25 sedan with black rims; images released
Seven of Second Harvest's eight trucks out of service
Repairs estimated at ~$80,000 and two to three weeks, per CEO Lori Nikkel
Aurora Foods/Aurora Importing donated $60,000 toward repairs
VP Duncan Salisbury told CityNews total costs could be about $100,000
Second Harvest delivers to more than 300 non-profits across Toronto
Four trucks damaged New Year's Day by apparent water in gas tanks; fence installed afterward
Acting Supt. Jeff Bangild scheduled to give update at 11:30 a.m. Oct. 15 at 22 Division
No arrest, named suspect or charges announced
TPS release 'Suspect Sought in a Theft Investigation' asks public for help
Security video shows at least two suspects (CityNews)

missed.text: Police case number 2026-2145903, Theft Over $5000, 22 Division
